title: APIs & external interfaces
description: Generic template: URL invocations (Open URL, Insert from URL, Import Records, cURL/MBS, Web Viewer, calculated URLs) classified by API family, plus external FileMaker / ODBC data sources. The API-family patterns are a broadly chosen cloud / SaaS default list — adjust the WHEN branches in `data/url_details.sql` + `data/api_families.sql` for project-specific classifications.
author: fm-lab

params.name: file
params.description: Optional file filter — derived from the app-level filter.

params.name: api_family
params.description: Restricts the detail list to a specific API family. 'All' (or empty) lifts the filter.

params.name: ref_type
params.description: Restricts the detail list to a reference type: 'Script Step', 'Plugin', 'Layout Object', 'Field' or 'Custom Function'.

params.name: step_name
params.description: Restricts the detail list to a script-step name (e.g. 'Open URL', 'Insert from URL', 'Import Records').

params.name: context
params.description: Restricts the detail list to a specific context (e.g. 'Web Viewer', 'Custom Function', 'Hide Calc').

params.name: source_type
params.description: Restricts the detail list to a source type ('Script (URL Step)', 'Script (Calc Step)', 'Custom Function', 'Field', 'Layout Object').
